race.description: Seeya For Coona Cup October 25th 2026 Mdn Plate
race.comment: POISED (12) is still a maiden after eleven starts. Could only manage to finish sixth last time out over 1007m at Taree following a minor placing at Mildura over 1100m the run prior. Terrific chance to break through from the good gate. SUNSET DRIVE (6) raced on the pace to the bend before fading to finish seventh over this journey at Cowra. Expected to measure up here. Top-three player. JUKEBOX EDITION (1) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start when fourth over 1200m at Quirindi. Capable of featuring prominently. YAHUSKIN (8) joins the new stable today and should appreciate resuming in easier company than what he's been racing in. Can feature.
